plugins.name: endurance-coach
plugins.description: Endurance coaching method: session start, readiness gates, strength prescription and check-ins, Garmin/Peloton workout procedure, data traps, planning, meals. Works with the coach-state, Garmin Connect and Peloton MCP connectors.

plugins.name: ballot-briefing
plugins.description: Ballot briefing: research every contest on a specific US ballot against the real duties of each office and produce a sourced, non-partisan, mobile-readable HTML briefing; then go deeper on any race the voter is still undecided about. Never recommends a candidate.
